form.notesHint: One line per level, for example “Top: Bergamot, Apple”.

sizes.title: Sizes and stock
sizes.hint: Each size has its own price and stock. Stock changes are always recorded in the history.
sizes.createHint: Add at least one size. The cost price is what the bottle costs you: it is used to calculate your profit.
sizes.label: Size name
sizes.onlyOne: A product needs at least one size.
sizes.deleteText: “{label}” will be removed. A size that belongs to a pack can't be deleted.

errors.label: Give each size a name (for example “50 ml”).
errors.duplicate: Two sizes have the same name.
errors.number: Prices, cost and stock must be whole numbers.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

stock.title: Adjust stock
stock.notePlaceholder: For example: supplier delivery, broken bottle…
stock.negative: You can't remove more than the current stock.

discount.title: Discount
discount.text: Customers see the old price crossed out next to the new price. It applies to every size.
discount.onHint: Turn off to go back to the normal price.
discount.datesHint: Leave empty to apply immediately and until you turn it off. Times are in Algeria's time.
discount.belowCost: Some sizes would sell below their cost price.

errors.value: Enter the value of the discount (a whole number above 0).
errors.percent: A percentage must be between 1 and 99.
errors.fixed: A fixed discount must be lower than the cheapest size ({price}).
errors.dates: The end must be after the start.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

archive.title: Archive
archive.text: Archiving hides the product from the shop but keeps it in past orders and statistics. You can restore it later.
archive.confirmText: “{name}” disappears from the shop. You can restore it anytime.
archive.archivedText: It is hidden from the shop. Restore it to sell it again (it stays hidden until you make it visible).
